status_labels.observed: read from the instructions or data of this blob
status_labels.inferred: purpose deduced from strings, register names or data flow

transport.to_scp: S_MBOX 0x07094000 channel 3: application processor writes MSGBOX_MSG_REG 0x0709407c; firmware polls MSG_STATUS 0x0709406c and clears RD_IRQ_STATUS bit 6
transport.from_scp: CPUX_MSGBOX 0x03004000 channel 3: firmware writes MSGBOX_MSG_REG 0x0300407c after MSG_STATUS 0x0300406c is below 8
transport.framing: word 0 = header; word 1 = payload word count (low byte); then count payload words

header.byte1: attribute (bit 1 synchronous: sender waits for a reply in the same framing)

transport.reception: polled from the main loop; no interrupt
transport.timeout: firmware: 100,000 tries of 1 ms per word; BL31 passes 4,000

to_scp.name: CPU operation
to_scp.handler: 0x400095a0; acts only when entry point != 0 and system state = 3 (system suspend)

to_scp.name: system operation
payload: state: 0 power-off after VBUS check, 1 or 2 reset, 3 power-off

to_scp.name: set wakeup source
payload: wakeup word: bits 31:30 = 3 for a timeout in ms in bits 29:0; otherwise bits 9:0 = GIC INTID - 32 from the wakeup table

from_scp.name: startup notification
from_scp.payload: 13 words copied from 0x4001067c (an empty version string in this build)

from_scp.name: feedback
from_scp.payload: the received message with byte 3 = result; for type 0x11 one word with the wakeup event
